u0: Neutral base and terminal state: no siren is ringing and you are not caught carrying food while the pot boils. Resume ordinary shop work: take a waiting client's order, fetch raw food from the pantry, prepare it at the stove for that order, and serve it. If the pot is already boiling while your hands are empty, go turn the stove down; if the siren starts or a boil catches you carrying food, move into the appropriate emergency handling. Return here once no emergency obligation remains.
uC: Carrying-during-boil state with the siren silent: you hold a portion of raw or prepared food while the pot is boiling over. Free your hands without abandoning the food: move to a free cell beside the stove, drop the portion, face the stove, toggle it down with empty hands, then pick the portion back up. If the siren starts, manage both alarms; if the food slips, pick it up on the very next move.
uCS: Combined emergency state: the siren is ringing, the pot is boiling over, and you are still holding food. Resolve both while keeping track of the portion: silence the siren at the switch when possible, and put the food down beside the stove, turn the stove down with empty hands, then retrieve the food. Either alarm may be handled first, but neither should be left running and the dropped item must not be forgotten. A slip while carrying requires immediate pickup.
uD: Empty-handed pot-fix state with the siren silent: the pot is boiling, your hands are empty, and the food you were carrying has normally been set down nearby. Go to the stove and toggle it with empty hands to stop the boil, then recover the dropped food. If you pick food up before the stove is down, the carrying-during-boil problem returns; if the siren starts, handle both. Do not serve or prepare until the carried item is recovered.
uDS: Combined empty-handed state: the pot is boiling, the siren is ringing, and your hands are empty while the set-down food still needs recovery. Address both alarms from empty hands: toggle the siren switch off and turn the stove down, in whichever order is convenient, then pick the food back up. After one alarm is solved the other remains active, so do not walk away and leave the food or an alarm unfinished.
uF: Fallen-food recovery state: the food has just slipped, your hands are empty, and the portion is on the floor in front of you. Your very next action must be to pick it up; do not turn, move, toggle, or handle another task first. After pickup, resume the siren, pot, and client work according to what is active; leaving the food on the ground keeps the recovery unfinished.
uR: Post-fix retrieval state with the siren silent: the stove has been turned down, but the food you set down is still on the floor and your hands are empty. Pick that portion back up and resume normal shop work. If the pot starts boiling again while you are still empty-handed, turn the stove down again; if the siren starts, combine silencing it with the retrieval. Once the food is back in hand and no alarm is active, return to the neutral workflow.
uRS: Post-fix siren state: the stove has already been turned down, but the siren is still ringing and your hands are empty because the food is on the floor. Go toggle the siren off, then pick the food back up. If the pot starts boiling again while you are empty-handed, fix it again before or after silencing. Do not forget the set-down portion once the alarm clears.
uS: Siren obligation state: the siren is ringing and there is no simultaneous pot-boiling-while-carrying problem, though you may be empty-handed or carrying and the pot may be boiling while your hands are empty. Go to the siren switch, face it, and toggle it off. If the pot is also boiling while you are empty-handed, turn it down as well; after the siren stops, resume the client/food workflow unless a carried-food boil still needs the set-down, fix, and pick-up sequence. A food slip requires immediate pickup.
